assumptions_challenged: An MCB/WCB has been created and characterized for SGL-001.
Three GMP‑like scale‑up production runs with release data and demonstrated lot comparability exist.
Orthogonal intact‑EV QC assays (with validated LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) have been completed for this program.
A validated, stability‑indicating potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint exists for SGL‑001.
Formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact‑EV recovery (ex vivo and in vivo controls) have been performed for the intranasal formulation.
Rodent intranasal biodistribution signals reflect intact EVs and are therefore predictive for larger species without additional orthogonal in vivo analytics.
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB and WCB documentation showing creation, identity, sterility/mycoplasma testing, and full characterization reports tied to the SGL‑001 source cell line.

Provide production records for ≥3 GMP‑like scale‑up batches including in‑process controls, release specifications, analytical release data, and a formal batch comparability assessment demonstrating reproducible physicochemical and potency profiles.

Provide validation reports for each orthogonal intact‑EV QC assay (particle count, protein/lipid markers, methods to exclude non‑vesicular particles) documenting LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and suitability for in vivo sample matrices.
Provide a validated, stability‑indicating potency assay with documented linkage (correlation) to an in vivo PD endpoint (including validation parameters and bridging data).

Provide formulation and device compatibility/recovery studies (ex vivo and in vivo controls) demonstrating intact‑EV recovery and demonstrating that manufacturing and administration do not generate confounding non‑vesicular signals.

Provide orthogonal intact‑EV analytics applied to in vivo biodistribution samples (rodent and at least one larger species) showing the detected signal is associated with intact vesicles rather than non‑vesicular material, together with assay validation for those matrices.
strongest_objection: The single supplied document (MISEV2023 guidance) only prescribes standards; there is no program-specific CMC, scale‑up, assay validation, stability, potency, or formulation/device recovery data for SGL-001. Therefore the program’s proposed readiness to compare lots or to advance an intranasal formulation into cross‑species PK/PD/bridging studies is unsupported and cannot be accepted.
